host.label: Host
host.placeholder: eg. grpcs://my_host or ydb.serverless.yandexcloud.net or lb.etn9txxxx.ydb.mdb.yandexcloud.net

service_account_json.label: Service account auth JSON
service_account_json.description: Service account auth JSON. Looks like {"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}. Will be used instead of IAM token and SA JSON file path field if specified.

service_account_json_path.label: Service account auth JSON file path
service_account_json_path.description: Service account auth JSON file path. File content looks like {"id": "...", "service_account_id": "...", "private_key": "..."}.

use_vm_metadata.label: Use VM metadata
use_vm_metadata.description: Optional. Whether to use VM metadata to retrieve IAM token
